items.prompt: On the first value 2 with target 4, what would inserting into seen BEFORE lookup incorrectly do?

options.why: No subtraction or negative multiplicity is involved.

options.text: Miss a pair with a future value.
options.why: The first arrival has no earlier partner; future partners are handled when they arrive.

options.text: Lose the current value from all later state.
options.why: Inserting early does not remove it; the problem is including it too soon.

options.text: Count the current index paired with itself.
options.why: The prefix map must exclude the current position until after its complement lookup.

items.explanation: The prefix map must exclude the current position until after its complement lookup.
